# ERC4626MultiTokenWrapper
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/extensions/ERC4626MultiTokenWrapper.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ERC4626MultiToken](./erc4626-multi-token.md), [IERC4626MultiTokenWrapper](../interfaces/extensions/ERC4626MultiTokenWrapper/ierc4626-multi-token-wrapper.md)

**Title:**
ERC4626MultiTokenWrapper

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

ERC-4626-shaped vault that batches deposits in ERC-1155 receipts and only forwards them
to a target ERC-4626 vault when an inheriting contract calls `_operate`. Lets users
interact at any block even when the target vault accepts capital only periodically.

On deposit, an ERC-1155 receipt is minted to the depositor for an id chosen by the
inheriting contract (typically the current round number). The id is the natural key for
attaching round-specific state, e.g. a per-round exchange rate, to the deposit.

The wrapper handles one of two asset pairings, depending on how the inheriting contract
configures `underlyingAsset` at construction:
- if `underlyingAsset == proxiedVault.asset()`, this vault accumulates the target vault's
underlying and `_depositOnTarget` exchanges it for target vault shares;
- if `underlyingAsset == proxiedVault` (the share token), this vault accumulates target
vault shares and `_redeemFromTarget` exchanges them for the target vault's underlying.


## State Variables
### _proxiedVault
STORAGE

The target ERC-4626 vault that `_depositOnTarget` and `_redeemFromTarget` operate
against. Exposed via `vault()`.


```solidity
IERC4626 private _proxiedVault
```


## Functions
### constructor

CONSTRUCTOR

Wires the wrapper to a target ERC-4626 vault and configures the asset this
wrapper accepts on `deposit`, along with the ERC-1155 receipt metadata URI.


```solidity
constructor(
    address proxiedVault,
    address underlyingAsset,
    string memory receiptsURI
)
    ERC4626MultiToken(underlyingAsset, receiptsURI);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proxiedVault`|`address`|The target ERC-4626 vault to wrap.|
|`underlyingAsset`|`address`|The asset this wrapper accepts on `deposit`. Configure as `proxiedVault.asset()` for an Input-style wrapper or `proxiedVault` (the share token) for an Output-style wrapper.|
|`receiptsURI`|`string`|The ERC-1155 metadata URI used for deposit receipts.|


### vault

Returns the address of the target ERC-4626 vault this wrapper batches deposits for.


```solidity
function vault() public view returns (address vaultAddress);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vaultAddress`|`address`|The address of the wrapped target vault|


### _redeemFromTarget

Redeems `amount` of this wrapper's accumulated balance (target vault shares) from the
target vault, paying out the target vault's underlying to this contract.


```solidity
function _redeemFromTarget(uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of target vault shares to redeem|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|assets The amount of underlying asset paid back by the target vault|


### _depositOnTarget

Deposits `amount` of this wrapper's accumulated balance (target vault's underlying)
into the target vault, receiving target vault shares to this contract.


```solidity
function _depositOnTarget(uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset to deposit|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|shares The amount of target vault shares minted to this contract|
